name: Grupo Herdez, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Grupo Herdez, S.A.B. de C.V., a food company, provides processed food in Mexico and internationally. It operates through Momentum, Canned Food, and Export segments. The company offers organic food; pasta; pasta, spicy, ketchup-type, homemade, hot, Worcestershire, soy, teriyaki, cooking, refrigerated, and taco sauces; coffee and coffee capsules; olives; chilies, dips, salsas, seasonings, tortillas, and tortilla chips; prepared drinks; ground tomato; frozen Mexican dishes; moles; canned vegetables; goat and mozzarella cheese; frozen popsicles and ice cream; tuna, beans, dips, guacamole, and vegetable juice; and enchiladas.
